		instance = {

  				"Operand": subStepData.get('Operand'),

  				"Value": subStepData.get('Value'),
  				"typeCheck": checkType
		}
		instances.append(instance)
	
	return instances

config.script:
newEntry = bool(self.view.params.newEntry)
	
	name = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Name").props.params.value
	seqNr = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("SequenceNr").props.params.value
	procedureID = self.view.params.procedureID
	username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	subStepsRepeater = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexRepeater").props.instances
	
	# Inserts for new step
	if newEntry == True:
		insertQuery = '''insert into SPMainStepsConfig
						    	(ProcedureID,
						    	SequenceNumber,
						    	Name,
						    	Created,
						    	CreatedBy)
						  values
						  		(?,
						  		?,
						  		?,
						  		?,
						  		?)'''
		insertArgs = [procedureID, seqNr, name, system.date.now(), username]
		mainStepID = system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertQuery, insertArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD', getKey = 1)
		
		for subStep in subStepsRepeater:
			system.perspective.print(subStep)
			checkType = subStep.typeCheck
			
			DataMapping = {
				1: {
					"Text": subStep.Text,
					"Mandatory": subStep.Mandatory
					},
				2: {
					"Text": subStep.Text,
					"LinkedTag": subStep.TagPath,
					"Operand": subStep.Operand,
					"Value": subStep.Value,
					"Mandatory": subStep.Mandatory
					},
				3: {
					"Text": subStep.Text,
					"Operand": subStep.Operand,
					"Value": subStep.Value,
					"Mandatory": subStep.Mandatory
					}
				}
			data = DataMapping[checkType]
			subStepInsertQuery = '''insert into 
										SPSubStepsConfig
									(MainStepID, CheckTypeID, Data)
									values (?, ?, ?)'''
			subStepInsertQueryArgs = [mainStepID, checkType, system.util.jsonEncode(data)]
			system.db.runPrepUpdate(subStepInsertQuery, subStepInsertQueryArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	# Update existing main step
	else:
		mainStepID = self.view.params.stepID
		updateQuery = '''update SPMainStepsConfig set
							Name = ?,
							SequenceNumber = ?
						where
							StepID = ?'''
		updateArgs = [name, seqNr, mainStepID]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(updateQuery, updateArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
		
		# get original substepIDs
		originalSubsteps = self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexRepeater").custom.SubStepsData
		originalStepIDs = []
		for row in range(originalSubsteps.getRowCount()):
			originalStepIDs.append(originalSubsteps.getValueAt(row, 'SubStepID'))
		
		newIDs = []
		# Loop over new steps
		for subStep in subStepsRepeater:
			checkType = subStep.typeCheck
			SubStepID = subStep.SubStepID
			newIDs.append(SubStepID)
			
			DataMapping = {
				1: {
					"Text": subStep.Text,
					"Mandatory": subStep.Mandatory
					},
				2: {
					"Text": subStep.Text,
					"LinkedTag": subStep.TagPath,
					"Operand": subStep.Operand,
					"Value": subStep.Value,
					"Mandatory": subStep.Mandatory
					},
				3: {
					"Text": subStep.Text,
					"Operand": subStep.Operand,
					"Value": subStep.Value,
					"Mandatory": subStep.Mandatory
					}
				}
			data = DataMapping[checkType]
			system.perspective.print(subStep.SubStepID in originalStepIDs)
			# Update existing if ID already exists
			if subStep.SubStepID in originalStepIDs:
				updateQuery = '''update 
									SPSubStepsConfig
								set 
									checkTypeID = ?,
									data = ?
								where
									SubStepID = ?'''
				updateArgs = [checkType, system.util.jsonEncode(data), SubStepID]
				system.db.runPrepUpdate(updateQuery, updateArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
			
			# Insert new if ID is unknown
			else:
				insertQuery = '''insert into
									SPSubStepsConfig
									(MainStepID, CheckTypeID, data)
									values (?, ?, ?)'''
				insertArgs = [mainStepID, checkType, system.util.jsonEncode(data)]
				newSubStepID = system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertQuery, insertArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD', getKey=1)
				newIDs.append(newSubStepID)
		
		# Remove IDs that got deleted
		for originalID in originalStepIDs:
			if originalID not in newIDs:
				deleteQuery = '''update 
									SPSubStepsConfig
								set
									Active  = 0
								where
									SubStepID = ?'''
				deleteArgs = [originalID]
				system.db.runPrepUpdate(deleteQuery, deleteArgs, database = 'NLSTWDYK_DB_PROD')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshSteps')
	
	self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Name").props.params.value = ''
	self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("SequenceNr").props.params.value = ''
	self.parent.parent.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("FlexRepeater").props.instances = []
	
	system.perspective.closeDock(self.parent.parent.getChild("Header").props.params.closeDockID)
